item.title: Northern Japan Alps: Hotaka, Yari and Japan's High Peaks — Guide
item.description: The Northern Japan Alps (Hida Mountains) rise to over 3,000 metres along Nagano’s western edge, forming some of the most dramatic high-mountain terrain in the country and home to iconic peaks including the spear-like Yarigatake and the Hotaka range, Japan’s third-highest mountain. These are serious mountaineering destinations, drawing experienced climbers to multi-day routes with mountain huts, rocky ridgelines and demanding ascents, while accessible base points like Kamikochi let less experienced visitors admire the peaks from the valley below without attempting the summits themselves.
